# note: sets: unique = primary MAPQ > 0; mapq0 = primary MAPQ 0; not_scored = MAPQ 0 and no row in the per-family table; identical = the --union-certificate run's row for the read's true family has n_decisive 0; family_psv = the per-family run's row for the true family has n_decisive >= 1; assigned = that row is 'assigned' and not origin-rejected; correct = assigned to the source copy or a catalog copy at the same locus (overlap >= 50% of the shorter span, score.py reads' rule); the certificate sets are 0 for MAPQ > 0 reads (the AS-tied gate does not score them); all from score.py reads --per-read

# note: foreign_claim = an assigned row of the per-family table names a locus other than the source's (score.py reads --per-read wrong_locus_rows > 0; in these runs always another family's row; the union certificate removes these rows)

# note: any_outcome / union_outcome (MAPQ-0 reads; 'na' otherwise) = the verdict a user can apply: any assigned row of the default per-family table / of the --union-certificate run (score.py reads ANY: correct, wrong, conflict = two loci claimed, abstain, not_scored = no row)

# note: twin (MAPQ-0 reads; 'na' otherwise) = _o2.twin_state over every alignment of the read (-F 2052): nm_twin = a placement not overlapping the source copy has AS equal to the best and the NM of the true-copy placement; as_tie_nm_differs = placements elsewhere reach the best AS, none with that NM; no_equal_as_elsewhere = the true copy holds the best AS alone; true_below_best = the best AS is elsewhere; no_true_placement = no alignment overlaps the source copy (register row 1103 reported nm_twin for all 990 scored tied molecules of the hash-seeded development run; this is the re-measurement on these runs)
# note: aligner_primary = the catalog copy with the largest raw overlap of the primary alignment's reference span: true_copy / other_copy / outside_catalog / unmapped
